status: post-opening metacommunity decomposition frozen before endpoint readback
sample: same 4,236 matched wet-dry route x seasonal-window pairs; exact-consecutive-year sensitivity prespecified

conceptual_unit.activity_boundary: beta metrics are calculated among stops containing at least one calling species in each run

primary_endpoints.name: delta_alpha_active
primary_endpoints.definition: wet minus dry mean species richness per active stop
primary_endpoints.prediction: positive; replication of within-active depth result

primary_endpoints.name: delta_gamma
primary_endpoints.definition: wet minus dry route-level active species richness
primary_endpoints.prediction: positive; replication of ecological pulse result

primary_endpoints.name: delta_mean_pairwise_sorensen_active
primary_endpoints.definition: wet minus dry mean pairwise Sorensen dissimilarity across all pairs of active stops within a run
primary_endpoints.prediction: two-sided; negative indicates spatial homogenization, positive indicates differentiation

primary_endpoints.name: delta_whittaker_beta_normalized_active
primary_endpoints.definition: wet minus dry normalized Whittaker beta among active stops: ((gamma/alpha_active)-1)/(n_active-1), defined for n_active>=2

secondary: mean pairwise Simpson turnover among active stops
mean pairwise nestedness-resultant dissimilarity among active stops

model.formula: response ~ rain_contrast + temp_difference + doy_difference + year_gap + C(State) + C(RunNumber)

interpretation_boundary.metacommunity: behaviourally realized acoustic metacommunity, not occupancy metacommunity
interpretation_boundary.homogenization: greater similarity of detected active assemblages among stops, not biotic homogenization through colonization/extinction
